brief: Pots on my balcony for three hot chilli pepper seedlings.

requirements.evidence: 3x prop:1-3 pot-s on covers of 3-cell triangle (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full), each filled with soil and visible in look view
No hot-chilli seedling exists in props (searches for chilli/chili/hot/pepper returned only pepper-seedling Sweet pepper); planted 3x pepper-seedling in the three pots as closest available
Compact 3-cell stand with covers, capped faces and locked joints; check_build ok, meshClash clear, no prop warnings; pots sit on top as balcony staging
requirements.requirement: Suitable for balcony use (small staged planter stand)

finish.summary: Built a compact 3-cell Hex Cluster stand with 3 terracotta S pots, each filled with soil and planted with a pepper seedling. No hot-chilli variety exists in the prop catalog, so sweet pepper seedlings stand in for hot chillis.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
